source_title: AliExpress Celebrates 11.11 Global Shopping Festival November 1-18 with Mega Deals as Brand+ Marks Its First Anniversary - PR Newswire

The 18-day event brings major discounts, trusted brands, fast delivery guarantees and added shopping perks for US consumers

Alongside deep discounts and special offers through Brand+, AliExpress' destination for trusted products, shoppers can access delivery protections, free shipping and returns on Choice items, and enhanced customer support . Faster Delivery Guarantees and Greater Confidence for US Shoppers
AliExpress continues to invest in the US customer experience. Today, approximately 95% of items available to US consumers qualify for the AliExpress Fast Delivery guarantee, which provides compensation coupons for qualifying delays and full refunds for eligible lost, damaged or late orders.
AliExpress further enhances customer value through its Choice program, offering a simpler, more reliable cross-border shopping experience with free shipping and returns on eligible items, clearer delivery commitments, enhanced logistics and customer support throughout the shopping journey. Together with the enhanced servicing protections and Brand+ and Choice order benefits, these programs reflect AliExpress' continued focus on delivering a seamless, reliable shopping experience and greater value for AliExpress customers.
The 11.11 Global Shopping Festival officially begins November 1 and runs through November 18, 2026. US shoppers can explore deals and offers through the AliExpress app or at AliExpress.com .
Launched in 2010, AliExpress is a global e-commerce platform dedicated to creating a better shopping experience for hundreds of millions of consumers in more than 200 countries and regions. In addition to the English version, the AliExpress platform is available in 15 other languages. AliExpress is part of Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group.
